findings: One new module, four re-exports. PackOnboardingPhase is strict-forward FSM (no skip), terminal states explicit (Activated success / Withdrawn failure). PackInstallStatus distinct from phase to allow per-step status without conflating with lifecycle position. RegionalRolloutGate is a value-object whose prerequisites are validated explicitly via check() — callers construct the gate with observed booleans and then call check() to produce a typed error if any prerequisite is unmet.

Strict-forward transition enforced via is_valid_next(from, to) explicit validator: single-step advance only, emergency Withdrawn permitted from any non-terminal, post-terminal moves rejected. Terminal states detected by is_terminal helper. from_wire round-trips with label() for serialization stability. NOTE: original evidence incorrectly described this guard as 'Ord+is_advance'; is_valid_next was absent at first commit and has since been added (P2 codex thread PRRT_kwDOSbSl2s6CnzKE + PRRT_kwDOSbSl2s6Cn3mf). Rebase onto the #109 queue head required preserving capability_pack and kr_regulatory exports plus adding pack_onboarding_phase; current regional-pack-domain local proof is 31/31 tests.

PackOnboardingPhase complements existing OnboardingPhase patterns. label()/from_wire pattern matches PR #62/#65/#86 et al — kernel-stable wire format. Module name pack_onboarding_phase singular per existing crate convention.
New module added to existing crate; lib.rs re-export pattern matches PR #60..#106 cascade. No new workspace member; no Cargo.toml touch.

architect.rationale: Smallest meaningful delta from M03-P07 plan. Strict-forward lifecycle correctly encoded; rollout gate explicit.

critic.rationale: Terminal states distinguished. Phase vs install-status separation matches the actual concern decomposition (lifecycle position vs per-step state).
